interpretation.error_definitions: Euclidean errors separately at the tag centre, rigid-object centre and centre of its top face. Optical depth is reported at the true tag centre and at the detected centre ray intersected with the simulator tag plane.
interpretation.pairing: Each view uses a fresh reset with a distinct depth-noise seed. Comparisons pair placement, initial height and step; the particular noise draws differ.
interpretation.physical_scope: Initial heights and free fall, sampled at six predetermined physics steps. There is no executed pick, lift, or hold in this grid.
interpretation.unavailable: All allocated rows remain in coverage. Error quantiles are conditional on a decoded pose.

limitations: Color-matched fragments have no unique target association or complete silhouette.
A successfully decoded unique mounted marker gives an ordered sample pose. Neither registration nor the sensor supplies a calibrated metric error envelope.

A square colored fragment has quarter-turn ambiguity. Ordered tag corners can distinguish orientation at a decoded sample only. Consecutive samples cannot exclude intervening translation, oscillation or complete turns.
